dct_title_s: Gap-Filled BRDF Corrected Radiance (Day/Night Band), NOAA-21 / VIIRS
dct_description_sm: A daily visualization from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), available from 2026-10-27 and updated as new data arrive. Made from VIIRS/JPSS2 Gap-Filled Lunar BRDF-Adjusted Nighttime Lights Daily L3 Global 15 arc-second Linear Lat Lon Grid NRT (VJ246A2_NRT, version 2, doi:10.5067/VIIRS/VJ246A2_NRT.002).

The second of the two Near Real Time (NRT)VIIRS DNB-based datasets is a daily moonlight- and atmosphere-corrected Nighttime Lights (NTL) product called VIIRS/JPSS1 Gap-Filled Lunar BRDF-Adjusted Nighttime Lights Daily L3 Global 500m Linear Lat Lon Grid. Known by its short-name, VJ246A2, this product contains seven Science Data Sets (SDS) that include DNB BRDF-Corrected NTL, Gap-Filled DNB BRDF-Corrected NTL, DNB Lunar Irradiance, Latest High-Quality Retrieval, Mandatory Quality Flag, Cloud Mask Quality Flag, and Snow Flag. The VJ246A2_NRT product files are provided in standard Hierarchical Data Format–Earth Observing System (HDF-EOS5) format.
